title: ChunkMetadata_v1
description: Per-chunk metadata schema for discoveryengine v1 structure and RAG corpus discovery for AI. schema (1st revision), covering the real-time analysis (RTA) pipelines.

doc_id.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the source PDF bytes (64 chars). Used as stable DataStore document ID — must be consistent across re-ingestion.

source_file.description: Original PDF filename (basename only, no path).

title.description: Inferred document or chapter title. Empty string if not determinable.

chapter.description: Nearest detected chapter or session heading above this chunk (e.g. 'Session 4: In Vivo Exposure'). Treatment manuals use session numbers as primary navigation units.

page_end.description: Last page of this chunk (1-indexed). Equal to page_start for single-page chunks.

chunk_index.description: Sequential zero-based index of this chunk within its parent document.

year_published.description: Publication year extracted from title page or copyright notice. 0 if not found. More recent year should be prioritized for up-to-date literature.

domain.description: Document-level primary orientation of the source text. Assigned once per document from the source's overall focus. Distinct from therapeutic_modality, which is chunk-level. Should correspond to a broader 'persona' -> i.e. a CBT practitioner, a DBT practitioner, an IPT practitioner that serves as umbrella when distinct modality documents insufficient. Documents that fall under broadly applicable practices (e.g. motivational_interviewing, crisis_intervention, therapeutic_alliance,+), fall into psychotherapy_general.

subdomain.description: Subdomain descriptor -- Narrower topic within the domain (e.g. 'CPT stuck point work', 'adolescent DBT', +). Free text for visual reference; not filterable by default.

doc_type.description: Document classification. including treatment_manual (for diagnosis/intervention focused material), textbook (for therapy modality material), and clinical_guideline (for standard clinical algorithms, psychometric materials), and other for other texts

therapeutic_modality.description: Chunk-level, loaded at start: the therapy modality or modalities this passage directly addresses. Primary filter for modality-specific RTA queries. For texts addressing multiple modalities, each appropriate tag is applied. Scoped to modalities within competence of CBT/DBT/IPT-trained clinicians. CBT: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (General and Depression), CPT: Cognitive Processing Therapy (PTSD), BA: Behavioral Activation (General and Depression), PE: Prolonged Exposure (PTSD), ERP: Exposure and Response Prevention (OCD), DBT: Dialectical Behavioral Therapy, ACT: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, MBCT: Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy, UP: Unified protocol, Schema: Schema Therapy. DBT: Dialectical Behavior Therapy, IPT: InterPersonal Therapy. MI: Motivational Interviewing. MI is designed to be retrieved across other modalities, others may or may not be segregated (e.g. CBT AND NOT DBT).

clinical_presentation.description: Clinical presentations or diagnostic themes this chunk addresses. OCD: obsessions and compulsions. SUD: substance use disorder.

session_event_tags.description: Any notable in-session event types this chunk directly addresses. Primary real-time retrieval trigger for the RTA pipeline. Motivational

session_phase.description: Where in the arc of treatment this chunk applies. pre_intake_consultation covers expectancy-setting and engagement work before formal treatment begins. crisis is phase-agnostic.

directionality.description: Does this chunk describe doing something, avoiding something, or a caution? Chunk-intrinsic — does NOT encode for-whom.

applies_when.description: The states/events/contexts under which this chunk's directionality is active. References the SAME controlled vocab as session_event_tags + clinical_presentation + a small state vocab (e.g. acute_suicidality, intoxication, insufficient_stabilization). Empty = applies whenever the modality is active.

technique_tags.description: Named clinical techniques referenced in the chunk (e.g. 'chain analysis', 'imaginal exposure', 'TIPP skills', 'Socratic questioning', 'cognitive restructuring', 'behavioral activation', 'interpersonal incident review'). Gemini-extracted proper technique names — distinct from keywords (topic terms). 0–10 items.

keywords.description: Key topic terms extracted by Gemini. 3–10 terms.

clinical_caution.description: Free field explicit contraindications or precautions stated in the chunk (e.g. 'contraindicated without prior stabilization work', 'requires dissociation assessment before proceeding', 'not appropriate in first three sessions'). The RTA system must surface caution flags alongside technique recommendations — not suppress them. Patient safety field: a technique recommended without its documented contraindication is dangerous. 0–5 items.

risk_dimension_tags.description: Ongoing risk monitoring dimensions this chunk addresses — distinct from crisis_escalation in session_event_tags, which is acute. The RTA system should run a passive background retrieval pass on every session using this field, not only when crisis_escalation fires. self_harm_nonsuicidal=NSSI pattern monitoring between episodes.

patient_population.description: Population for whom this chunk's evidence or recommendation applies. Critical for treatment matching — prevents an adult veteran PTSD RCT from being weighted equally with a civilian adolescent sample. bipoc is a broad designation; specify population in subdomain. Used as a ranking moderator when filtering evidence_base IN [rct_primary, rct_moderator, meta_analytic].

clinical_measure_tags.description: clinical instruments referenced, normed, or interpreted in the chunk. Use exact canonical abbreviation (normalize PHQ9 / PHQ 9 / Patient Health Questionnaire-9 to PHQ-9 in _fallback_extraction). Enables routing to specific instrument guidance in analysis_function=outcome_monitoring queries.

notes.priority_for_reviewer: these notes are likely out of date and need comprehensive review.
notes.vertex_ai_search: String and integer scalar fields are registered as filterable attributes in the DataStore schema. Array fields (therapeutic_modality, clinical_presentation, session_event_tags, analysis_function, patient_population, risk_dimension_tags, outcome_measure_tags, clinical_caution, technique_tags, population_focus, setting, presentation_coverage, intended_use_context, source_language) must be explicitly registered as filterable attributes (type 'key' or 'text') in setup_vertex_search.py for retrieval filter use. missingness is informational only and does not require filterable registration. Schema changes require purge_datastore.py --confirm followed by full re-ingestion. See config/ISSUES.md for DataStore registration checklist.
notes.domain_vs_modality: domain is a document-level property assigned from the source's primary orientation (set once per document). therapeutic_modality is a chunk-level property extracted from passage content and may differ from the document's domain. This distinction must appear in the Gemini extraction prompt to prevent inconsistent tagging.
notes.routing_safety: corpus_scope=asa_only is a correctness constraint on the RTA searcher, not a soft signal. target_audience=patient is a hard exclusion from all retrieval paths except analysis_function=homework_resource. Both filters must be implemented as pre-filters in the searcher, not as ranking adjustments.
notes.representation_and_implementation_fields: population_focus, source_language, setting, adaptation_status, missingness, and presentation_coverage describe source-level provenance and representation gaps. study_type, sample_size, and intended_use_context describe source-level methodological and functional context. All nine fields are document-level properties set once per document, distinct from chunk-level fields (evidence_base, patient_population) which describe individual passage content. See config/ISSUES.md I-16 through I-22 for extraction and routing guidance.
notes.recommended_change_items: Fields added from RECOMMENDED CHANGE blocks in corpus notes (included in this schema): UP in therapeutic_modality; dissociative_disorders/health_anxiety/hoarding/bfrb/autism_spectrum/perinatal in clinical_presentation; shame_activation/somatic_activation/therapist_self_disclosure/avoidance_safety_behavior/minority_stress_disclosure/cultural_mismatch/premature_termination_signal/grief_loss_activation in session_event_tags; pre_intake_consultation in session_phase; use_with_caution/contraindicated/empirically_derived in practice_recommendation_level; clinical_caution/training_level_required/risk_dimension_tags fields; termination_planning in analysis_function; open_ended in time_horizon. SE and SP from the original RECOMMENDED CHANGE blocks were removed in the CBT/DBT/IPT scope pruning pass. Representation and implementation fields added from proposed_changes_metadata_schema.md (2026-06-25): population_focus, source_language, setting, adaptation_status, missingness, presentation_coverage, study_type, sample_size, intended_use_context. Review config/ISSUES.md for items requiring corpus acquisition decisions.
notes.removed_fields: Removed from prior schema: entities (superseded by technique_tags), evidence_level GRADE A/B/C/D (superseded by practice_recommendation_level). Update ingestion/metadata_gen.py _fallback_extraction() to not populate these fields.
